content: A Praise to the Protector.Oṃ. Homage to the Protector of the World.Guru of the world, praised by the three realms of existence,Foremost of gods, praised by Māra and Brahmā,Supreme King of Sages, who accomplishes all through being praised,Homage to the supreme Protector of the three worlds.You possess the body of the infinite Sugata, the holder of the sublime form.You wear the Sugata Amitābha as your crown ornament.With your right hand in the gesture of supreme generosity, you dispel the hunger and thirst of the hungry ghosts.With your left hand, you are perfectly adorned with a golden lotus.You possess fragrant, matted locks of hair that flicker with a reddish-yellow hue.Your full face is as beautiful as the moon.Your lotus-eyes are supremely excellent and wide.You are as pure white as snow or a conch shell, and you possess a sweet fragrance.You are the one who holds a cluster of immaculate, lustrous pearls.You are adorned with the beautiful, radiant light of the crimson dawn.Your hands are arranged like a lotus lake.You possess the color of autumn clouds and are forever youthful.You are the one whose two upper arms are adorned with many precious jewels.You are the one whose palms are youthful and soft like the finest leaves.You are the one whose left breast is covered by a deerskin.You are the one who elegantly wears earrings, bracelets, and various ornaments.You are the one who dwells upon a supreme, stainless lotus.You are the one whose navel is as soft as a lotus petal.You are the one whose supreme golden belt is embellished with jewels.You are the one who wears a lower robe of finest cloth wrapped around your waist.You are the one who has reached the far shore of the great ocean of the Sage’s supreme wisdom.You are the one who has attained excellence, having closely accumulated vast merit.You are the source of constant bliss, the one who dispels old age and illness.You are the one who brings the three to an end and demonstrates the conduct of the celestial realms.You are the one who is supreme among embodied beings and victorious over the tumultuous hordes of Māra.You are the one whose feet are made enchanting by the sound of golden anklets.You are the one who dwells in solitude through the four divine abodes.You are the one who walks with the gait of a swan and the majesty of a proud elephant.You are the one who has fully gathered the accumulations and upholds the teachings.You are the one who liberates from the ocean of milk and the ocean of water.Whoever always rises at dawn and with devotion,Mindfully contemplates the Lord Avalokiteśvara.If one offers this supreme praise, clearly and purely,Whether one be a man or a woman,In this life and in all future births,All worldly and transcendent needs will be fulfilled.It is said that if one is able to recite this praise, its potency of blessing is unlike any other.
